title: Safe2Link
tagline: Share crypto instantly from your Safe accounts via links
description:
So, when folks dive into crypto transactions, it's pretty common to do a little test run before going all-in. You know, because once those transactions go through, there's no turning back, and trusting those destination addresses can be a bit iffy. Even in the world of crypto gifting, we often rely on escrow services to keep things smooth.

But hey, we've got an idea to shake things up a bit – how about crypto transactions through links? Picture this: you can claim your crypto just by clicking on a link, and it comes straight out of programmable wallets like Safe. Cool, right?

**Links**
- [https://safe2link.xyz/](https://safe2link.xyz/)
- [https://github.com/koshikraj/safe2link](https://github.com/koshikraj/safe2link)
